record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale observed-item input vectors by 0.75 + 0.5 times the percentile rank of log1p(item training frequency), computed separately per category from training interactions only. Leave padding zero and mask-token scaling at 1; never use masked target identities to construct features. This bounded frequency cue may improve context reliability. Keep learned embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed; persist frequency features for identical prediction preprocessing.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four categories, scale observed context vectors by 0.75 + 0.5 times the percentile rank of log1p training frequency. This bounded cue may improve context reliability while preserving learned embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Padding stays zero and the exclusive mask retains scale 1. The checkpointed buffer is restored by the existing predictor writer, which imports the updated model class.
